Educational crop model

Growing conditions, yield, and quality

The model links water, nutrients, and weather assumptions with plant condition and an estimated output profile. It is not an agronomic forecast.

Model overview

Each run follows one simple path from setup to plant response to final result.

1
Field inputs

Water, feed, climate

2
Plant response

Growth, structure, maturity

3
Final result

Class, quality, size

Inputs can be changed before each run.

Step 1

Scenario assumptions

Water, nutrient, and weather values define the conditions used in the model.

Playback

Run controls

Changing an input resets the scenario. The Run button calculates and animates the updated setup.

The current assumptions are loaded. A changed setup is applied when the Run button is pressed.

Primary inputs

Water and nutrients

Water and nutrient values affect plant growth, site retention, output quality, and estimated yield in the model.

Weather assumptions

Climate and stress

Temperature, humidity, wind, rain, and solar radiation contribute to the modeled environmental stress.

Modeled relationships

From inputs to estimated output

The canvas shows the logic from left to right: inputs shift first, the plant responds next, and final output settles last.

1 Inputs shift

Water, nutrients, and weather intensity change first.

2 Plant reacts

Growth, structure, and maturity respond next.

3 Yield outcome lands

Size mix, quality, loss, and class settle last.
